verdict.rationale: Edge0 ships its own `edge0 serve` command that exposes an OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions HTTP endpoint, so the serving capability itself is first-party. The only documented access example targets 127.0.0.1 (localhost), and nothing shows the server can bind to a LAN interface or be reached from other devices. Missing for 10: documented host/bind option (e.g. 0.0.0.0) for local-network exposure, evidence of access from other devices, network auth/security guidance, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can serve models over my local network for access from other devices
